input:
The value of lim as x->a of (sqrt(a+2x)-sqrt(3x)) / (sqrt(3a+x)-2sqrt(x)) is

Options:
A. 1/(3sqrt(3))
B. 2/sqrt(3)
C. 2/(3sqrt(3))
D. 4/(3sqrt(3))

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Evaluate a 0/0 radical limit as x approaches a.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Both numerator and denominator go to 0 at x=a, so use first-order expansion or rationalization.

key_formulas.expansion: sqrt(u+h) approx sqrt(u) + h/(2sqrt(u)) near h=0

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Set x=a+h and keep first-order terms in h for numerator and denominator.
logical_steps: Step 2: Expand each square root to first order in h

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: First-order terms in h determine the limit and simplify to 2/(3sqrt(3)).
